caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar and its matching lid, displayed against a plain, off-white background. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly wider mouth and a pronounced rim, which is rendered in a rusty brown glaze on the inside and along the edge. The body of the jar is colored with a mix of mossy green, olive, and brown hues, featuring an uneven surface pattern with lighter green drips and patches, as well as scattered orange spots. The base of the jar is a darker, earthier brown. The lid, placed on its side in the foreground to the right of the jar, shares the same mottled green, brown, and orange coloration, with a raised central knob. There is minimal shadow cast below the jar and lid. The artist’s signature, “WILLIAM SHECKER,” appears in small, light text to the left of the jar.
title: Galena Covered Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
